headline: Advertised zoning changes for Grove, Brookfield and Milton streets, set a tax classification hearing, and denied a Roosevelt Elementary pickup report.
summary: Dozens of resident requests, mostly on traffic and streets, were referred to committees. The council also ordained 25 salary ordinances and confirmed two appointment votes, each 10-1. It held the rodeo draft ordinance under privilege.
decisions: Held the zoning map request for 416 Belmont St. and nearby properties under privilege, at Councilor Bilotta's request.
Referred the tax increment exemption agreement and housing project application for 27 Chandler St. and 53 Irving St. to the Economic Development Committee, 11-0.
Held the rodeo draft ordinance under privilege, at Councilor King's request.
Set a public hearing for November 17, 2026 on the FY27 tax classification, 11-0.
Referred the update on the $100M investment in street and sidewalk resurfacing to the Public Works Committee, 11-0.
Confirmed the reappointment of Benetta Kuffour to the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board of Trustees, 10-1.
Confirmed reappointments of five people to the Citizens Advisory Council, 10-1.
Adopted an order asking the city manager to consider an emergency preparedness plan for demonstrations and unrest, 10-1.
Adopted, as amended, an order asking for a report on recruiting developers to build in Worcester, 10-1.
Adopted an order asking for an action plan for parent pickup and dropoff at Roosevelt Elementary School, 10-1.
Denied King's motion for a report on student pickup and dropoff near Roosevelt Elementary School, 3-8.
Adopted, as amended, an order for reflective tape and signage at new speed humps, 11-0.
Adopted, as amended, an order for a pedestrian safety plan at Lake Ave. and Anna St., 11-0.
Adopted an order asking for a review of the street tree replacement policy, 11-0.
Adopted an order asking for a report on using drones to track reckless bicycle and e-bike riders, 11-0.
Placed on file King's order for more information on the U.S. Department of Justice report on Worcester police, 8-3.
Advertised a proposed ordinance to rezone 13 properties on Grove, Brookfield and Glennie streets to business use, 11-0.
Advertised a proposed ordinance to rezone 15, 17 and 19 Milton St. to residential use, 11-0.
Advertised a proposed ordinance to change the zoning of 455 Grove St. to entirely business, 11-0.
Advertised a proposed zoning map amendment for the Belmont Street / Plantation Street corridor, 11-0.
Advertised a proposed ordinance extending BG-3 and CCOD-E zoning to properties on Charlton, Hermon and Beacon streets, 11-0.
Ordained an amendment to establish a tow zone on portions of Albany Street and Fantasia Drive, 11-0.
Ordained 25 ordinances amending salary ordinances for multiple positions, 11-0.
Authorized a five-year lease for ten special education buses for Worcester Public Schools, 11-0.
Referred a request for an ordinance on cannabis social consumption establishments to the Economic Development Committee, 10-0.
